usage.outputShape: body.data.items[].formattedAddress (full string); structured parts in body.data.items[].address{road,suburb,city,county,state,postcode,country,countryCode}; latitude/longitude on each item; body.data.total = count
usage.guide: Reverse-geocode a coordinate to a human-readable address. Send a GET to https://2s.io/api/geocode/reverse with required query params lat (-90..90) and lon (-180..180); no request body. The x402 payment ($0.001 USDC on Base) is handled by the pay layer. On success you get 200 with results in body.data.items[]; read body.data.items[0].formattedAddress for the full address string, or body.data.items[0].address for structured fields (road, city, state, postcode, country). body.data.total gives the number of matches.
